title: Iconic Paris canal opens to swimmers as residents seek ways to cope with heatwave
summary: As France is bracing for another heatwave, Paris is allowing swimming in one of its canals so residents could cope with the heat. It will be the second spell of hot temperatures this year, after an unusually scorching week in May.
